Some technologies, such as STATBELT Utility, statistical software packages, and many probability
apps, allow you the option to conduct a hypothesis test without first computing the test statistic.
STATBELT and these apps will ask you to input the hypotheses and the sample data, then will compute
the test statistic and P-Value for you. This is a shortcut when compared to the first two examples. But,
Sample evidence suggests the alternative is likely true.
